issuesTolerance: zero; any key under qualityIssues is a hard failure

informational.dewpointAboveMeanTempNote: Dew point more than 0.5 degC above the daily mean while RH is at least 90 %: a near-saturated marine day compressed into daily aggregates. The ET0 computation clamps the dew point to the daily mean and flags the row in `tdewClamped`.
informational.dewpointAboveTminNote: Tmin and Tdew are different aggregations of the same day and cross routinely in humid climates. Recorded, never removed.
